### Review Summary (`approved`)

- **Correctness**: Implements `ANNOTATION_PREVIOUS_NAMES`, `parseEntityPreviousNames`, `final_entity_previous_names` migration and stitcher sync, `DefaultEntitiesCatalog`/`AuthorizedEntitiesCatalog` redirect resolution, `GET /entities/by-name/:kind/:namespace/:name/redirect`, `CatalogClient`/`InMemoryCatalogClient` methods, and Catalog/TechDocs frontend redirects per `change_plan.md`.
- **Type safety**: All new public exports carry `@public` JSDoc tags, OpenAPI server/client types and API Extractor/SQL reports are in sync, and no `any` casts are introduced.
- **Error handling**: `parseEntityPreviousNames` safely skips malformed/cross-kind/self references, the router records auditor failure events and returns `404 NotFoundError` when no unique redirect exists, and frontend hooks fall back to not-found states on redirect lookup errors.
- **Authz**: `AuthorizedEntitiesCatalog.entityRedirect` enforces `catalogEntityReadPermission` (`DENY`, `CONDITIONAL` via `FilterPredicate`, and `ALLOW`) before returning any redirect target.
- **DRY**: Previous-name parsing and validation are shared via `parseEntityPreviousNames` in `@backstage/catalog-model` across backend stitching and `InMemoryCatalogClient`.
- **Test coverage**: Unit and integration tests cover `parseEntityPreviousNames`, stitcher sync and `ON DELETE CASCADE`, `DefaultEntitiesCatalog` (single match, live entity precedence, multi-claimant ambiguity, permission filters), `AuthorizedEntitiesCatalog`, `createRouter`, `CatalogClient`, `InMemoryCatalogClient`, and both legacy and alpha Catalog/TechDocs pages.
